name: Projected Mesh Filtering
definition: A technique to filter a mesh by projecting its vertices onto a 2D plane, determining which vertices fall within the convex hull or bounding region of projected ground-truth contours, and removing vertices/triangles outside this region.
summary: Projected Mesh Filtering removes mesh geometry outside a ground-truth reference by projecting vertices onto orthogonal planes and cutting based on 2D containment, differing from simplification by using external spatial data rather than intrinsic metrics.
